summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input is historical compatibility only, never auto-promoted; v2 roles: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first 3 authorize; separate sourceSelectionHash (roles/paths/modules/scope/resources) and sourceContentHash (selected bytes); adapter owns paging/coverage/continuation/truncation, complete bounded-lossy summaries are not truncated; ready receipts are immutable generations at skill-input-generations/<binding-hash> with validated atomically advanced non-authorizing current pointer; consumers resolve pointer only, no mtime/suffix/scan; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derived from changed-set and canonical path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current/references/unexpired attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate consumers to v2 before 8-18 creates current receipt; old skill-input-current dirs remain historical immutable evidence; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap created; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059; supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
